facts.text: The Lodge at Woodloch is an all-inclusive spa resort in the Poconos, Pennsylvania.
facts.excerpt: our all-inclusive spa resort in Poconos, Pennsylvania gives you an opportunity to shift from your everyday routine

facts.text: The resort is an adults-only spa resort offering body treatments, massages, facials and salon services.
facts.excerpt: Our luxury adults-only spa resort in the Poconos offers a unique selection of expert body treatments, massages, facials, and salon services

facts.text: The resort offers over 50 classes and offerings per day.
facts.excerpt: With over 50 unique classes and offerings per day, there are endless things to do at our resort in the Poconos.

facts.text: All packages include accommodations and three consecutive gourmet meals per night of stay.
facts.excerpt: All packages at our Pennsylvania resort include lavish accommodations, three consecutive artfully-crafted gourmet meals per night of stay

facts.text: Packages include speakers and workshops, creative arts, group fitness and mind/body classes, cooking and baking demonstrations, and group outdoor adventure excursions.
facts.excerpt: Guests are welcome to avail themselves of inspiring creative arts, scheduled group fitness and mind/body classes, cooking and baking demonstrations, scheduled group outdoor adventure excursions

facts.text: Included health and fitness amenities feature an indoor pool, Hydromassage WaterWalls, indoor and outdoor whirlpools, steam rooms, saunas, a Snow Room, a Tyrolean Bucket Shower and a Himalayan Salt Sauna.
facts.excerpt: indoor pool, Hydromassage WaterWalls, indoor and outdoor whirlpools, steam rooms, saunas, Snow Room, Tyrolean Bucket Shower, Himalayan Salt Sauna

facts.text: The resort has a 3,000-square-foot CardioWeight Studio.
facts.excerpt: a state-of-the-art 3,000 square foot CardioWeight Studio

facts.text: The Aqua Garden has Hydromassage WaterWalls and an activity pool with floor-to-ceiling windows surrounded by nature.

facts.text: The spa has a co-ed Whisper Lounge.

facts.text: Guest speakers and events cover topics including life, love, self, spirituality, health, music, healing and the environment.
facts.excerpt: Diverse opportunities are offered to discover a greater understanding of life, love, self, spirituality, health, music, healing, the environment and our world.

facts.text: TREE Restaurant and Bar is elevated among the tree canopy with glimpses of the resort's private lake.
